rows.actual_D_scope: No augmented target graph generated. Existing source degree histograms/structural regularity and forced-class R2 covering numbers only.
rows.scope: Current D4 degree4..12 records: no old degree slack. D3 q8 actual585/650/715 sources: all eligible pins, same cap, all old edges retained. Additional canonical regularD3 source histograms retained in evidence.
rows.failure_or_result: D4 fixedsources全满度；实际D3 source650全10regular。585和715的eligible-R2 cover最优恰65，分别超过9/11pins预算；715虽全部eligible球的union=715，仍不能用11球覆盖。小互助块585 t≤7、715 t≤5也由65spokes下界排除。
positive_guarantees: 保留所有旧边可保持oldold近端覆盖，但新增点仍须完整R_(D-1)覆盖。
65个特殊类给出每类至少一pin的精确覆盖下界；不是把union覆盖误作有限budget覆盖。
rows.unclosed_gap: Not a nonexistence theorem for arbitrary586/651/716 or D4 baseline+1 graphs; larger cooperative585/715 blocks, deleted/replaced old edges and genuinely new sources remain outside this scope.
rows.lesson_and_restart_condition: 满度源立即止；有余量先看可选pins在全部必要目标类上的覆盖下界。只在获得有实际度余量的新非同构source或改变连接机制/全局路由规则时重开，不换seed或重编号重复闭族。

rows.actual_D_scope: No successful full target candidate. Eight variant counts are sourcevertices/partitions/necessary-root failures, not ordinary badpairs. Calibration metrics remain inside each variant.
rows.scope: One fixed operation: split sourcev into adjacentu,w; disjoint nonempty parts ofcompleteN(v), no other oldedge change. Eight actualsources acrossD3/D4/D5; every sourcevertex and unorderedpart completed. Separate capacity proof excludes specifiedotherdegree targets without fake enumeration.
rows.failure_or_result: 八源共1981530无序分割，其中容量拒1321591、精确新根检查659939，全部规范S侧新根已失败，0完整候选。D5虽NB容量全过，首步geodesic singleton阻碍说明走步数余量不能替代两侧路线互补。
positive_guarantees: 旧点度不变，新两点度由part大小+1精确控制。
newroot条件只作必要筛；若通过才检查oldold和producer全图BFS，不冒充整图成功。
完整规则和数值预筛在各PROPOSITION中给出；D5受影响旧对可限于R1_H(N)端点，但本批无新根通过，后阶段未执行。
rows.unclosed_gap: Other nonisomorphic253/810/104/441/684/650/1518/2810sources and general targetorder graphs remain open. Multi-split, overlapping attachments and other oldedge changes are different mechanisms, not excluded here.
rows.lesson_and_restart_condition: 按NB根容量选择参数，容量过线后还要每个最远层目标能从两侧首步到达。当前实际源存在独占首步远目标，邻集不能仅靠相邻两点分开。按约暂停该方向；只在明确改变连接机制或取得有不同覆盖结构的新source时重开，不续seed/局部bad优化或自动跨case。
